Arpan Saxena vs State Of U.P. And Another on 10 April, 2025

Heard Mr. Arun Gupta, Senior Advocate assisted by Mr. Manish Gupta, learned counsel for the applicant-Arpan Saxena, Mr. Pradeep Kumar, learned counsel for the applicant-Ankit Saxena, Ms.
Ankita Priydarshani (opposite party no.2), appearing in person as well as Mr. Amit Singh Chauhan,
learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

The present applications are filed with a prayer to quash the charge sheet No.37 of 2020 dated 21.2.2021 along with Cognizance/Summoning order 09.03.2021 as well as the entire criminal proceeding against the applicants arising out of Criminal Case No.1634 of 2021 (State vs. Ankit Saxena), arising out of Case Crime No.194 of 2020, under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471 I.P.C.
and Section 66C/72/72(a) Information Technology (Amendment) Act, pending in the court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Azamgarh, Police Station- Nizamabad, District- Azamgarh.

entities.text: Criminal Case No.1634 of 2021 (State vs. Ankit Saxena
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
An order has been passed on to the Court today wherein in Transfer Petition (Criminal) No.410 of 2021 (Ankita Priyadarshini vs. Ankit Saxena & Ors.), the Apex Court by order dated 18th October,
2022 has transferred the Case No.1634 of 2021 titled as State vs. Ankit Saxena, pending before the Court of CJM Azamgarh, U.P. to the Court of CJM, Dwarka, New Delhi and has allowed the transfer application.

entities.text: Transfer Petition (Criminal) No.410 of 2021 (Ankita Priyadarshini vs. Ankit Saxena & Ors.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The copy of the aforesaid order passed on to the Court today is taken on record.

Mr. Arun Gupta, Senior Advocate assisted by Mr. Manish Gupta and Mr. Pradeep Kumar appearing on behalf of the respective applicants therein state that in view of the orders passed in the aforesaid transfer petition by the Apex Court, the matter is rendered infructuous thus, it may be dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to place their case before the appropriate Court in case required.
Ms. Ankita Priydarshani, opposite party no.2 who has appeared in-person has also accepted the fact that the matter has been transferred and is being heard by the Court of CJM, Dwarka, New Delhi.
In view of the aforesaid, both the applications filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C. are dismissed as withdrawn with the aforesaid liberty.
The interim orders granted therein stand discharged.
